items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: I got with James and I said, “Look, this is what I have to do for this audition.” So we went through it... And it worked out really well.

ctx.x: Well you didn’t have to have the greatest tone and all that.

Yeah. I was no good on the flute. And I played piccolo in the marching band. I was no good. The tenor was my M.O. So anyway I had to work on a — anyway I knew all my scales and all that kind of stuff, but they just didn’t sound the same on flute you know? So James, when I went down to Pomona to the black pre-freshman program, I got with James and I said, “Look, this is what I have to do for this audition.” So we went through it, and okay, we’ll work on a few things. We’ll work on this Debussy thing and then we’ll…
